name: Student Pass

requirements.blocker_text: Enrolled in a learning institution in Uganda, evidenced by an admission letter and a support letter from the institution.

evidence_required.document: Support letter from the educational institution
Evidence of fee payment to the institution

sources.title: Directorate of Citizenship and Immigration Control, Uganda -- Student Pass: USD 100 flat fee regardless of duration chosen (3/6/12 months), East African nationals exempted from the fee; processed online via visas.immigration.go.ug with in-person biometric capture

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Uganda). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 DCIC sourced. STRUCTURAL FINDING: the USD 100 fee is FLAT regardless of the 3/6/12-month duration selected, unlike most other countries' student routes in this dataset where fees scale with duration -- meaning there's no cost advantage to choosing a shorter pass, only an administrative one (fewer renewals needed for longer stays). East African Community (EAC) nationals are explicitly fee-exempt, reflecting Uganda's EAC regional-integration commitments. No explicit post-study work-visa conversion pathway was found; switchable_to ug_work_permit reflects the general possibility of a subsequent employer-sponsored application, not a dedicated graduate-route mechanism.
